d.ko: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.
d.en: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.
d.zh: 《Super Woden》备受赞誉的衍生作品，将经典的街机精髓与深度玩法相结合，并充满了对汽车文化的真挚热爱。凭借独特的个性，Rally Edge 带你回到一个娱乐至上的时代，超越现实的极限。
